exact_test: For five predeclared paired seeds, compare the exact author-iDDPM SW2 and MSW2 at the largest and smallest directions of the accepted one-million-network SAD estimator.

acceptance.pairwise: largest minus smallest is positive for every seed and both metrics
acceptance.uncertainty: the exact percentile 95% interval over all 5^5 paired bootstrap resamples is strictly above zero for both metrics
acceptance.integrity: all ten endpoint exact-setup and independent-checker flags pass
acceptance.negative_control: reversing endpoint labels must fail the positive-effect rule

scope: Faithful paper-scale endpoint corroboration. It directly tests endpoint generation preference but not the paper's multi-direction trend. The smallest full-estimator eigenvector is used deterministically but fails the preregistered cross-shard individual-vector stability gate.
